content: Adama ge Ive Yehoba wana Logugui Hi Leke
Bwasumu bolo Yehoba Yabowaine i ginolil gamwaliyaa, he gegewel mwata i siba lakel. Yaka mwata i baek yova elana i ba, “Age Yabowaine ebwakil gegewel eyowa gamwanaa enowaliya i lopwali bahi nuku aan?”
Inoke yova mwata anana i lahe i ba, “Bosowaina ya ebwakil gegewel eyowa gamwanaa enowaliya naha anan ya,
iyai ya te ebwakil toto i siuna eyowa nuwanaa enowana nige naha aan. Yabowaine i ba, ‘Ebwakil o enowana bahi nuku aan o ebo nuku pipihikan, eba nuku aliga.’”
Yaka mwata i baek yova elana i ba, “Nigeya! Nige nuku aaliga.
Yabowaine i ba ola o kaiwena i atena te sauga ebo nuku an, he abwe matamiu ni mwapwela yaka bugul gegewena waiwaisana ge nanakina nuku atena ge nuku ola iya Yabowaine.”
Yova ebwakil i kite ana awa i waisi ge enowana i waisi aanan kaiwena. I ola al i nuwatu i ba, “I waisi te na an inoke na siba.” Inoke enuna i ahe i an. I ola al enuna i pek lagona i an.
Yaka mataliya i mwapwela ge hi kitel age hi bokaboka, inoke poga lamwana hi bugulan ge hi helil tuwaliya ana ekaukaus.
Kokoyaviya vetutulina elana Yehoba Yabowaine i nawanawa eyowa gamwanaa, yaka butuna tau ge lagona hi hago, inoke hi na hi bunsumi ebwakil gamwaliyaa.
Yaka Yehoba Yabowaine i yoga tau elana i ba, “Owa ga?”
Anana tau i lahe i ba, “Butum ya hago u nawanawa eyowa gamwanaa, inoke ya lovakun ge ya bunsumi, kaiwena ya bokaboka.”
Inoke Yehoba Yabowaine i ba, “Ga i ola ge u atena te u bokaboka? Henala ge wam wasa i pewa? Bi ola ebwakil toto ya lopwali enowana u an?”
Yaka tau i ba, “Yova toto u pem alou, iya te ebwakil o enowana enuna i pem ya an.”
Inoke Yehoba Yabowaine i baek yova elana i ba, “Ga i ola ge u ginol ola o?” Yaka yova i ba, “Mwata i kakaweyau inoke ya ahe ya an.”

Yaka Yehoba Yabowaine i baek mwata elana i ba, “Kaiwena ginol ya u ginol, inoke sauga ya na ba nuwamut-agiwa ge am lahi na baunan. Am pulowan bwasumu gegewel totounuwal ge bekikil ali pulowan ni bwata lake. Yawalim ana minamina gegewena elana, tinem nu uluwan ge bilibili pwapwalanana kokowam ni papakove.
Na ba owa alom ge yova nuku pepihigelgel-agimiu, i ola al tubutubunim ge iya tubutubunina nihi pepihigelgel-agil. Tubutubunina etega kokowam abwe ni puligebal ge owa aena gunina nu tal.”
Yaka i baek yova elana i ba, “Na ba owa wam liyan elana pulowan ni gewi nu pwawa, ge wam ab elana lomwan bwabwatana nu pwawa. Lagom ana nuwan ni gasisi eliyam ge iya ni logugui-agiwa.”

Yaka i baek Adama elana i ba, “Owa lagom wana baaba u hago ge ebwakil enowana toto ya lopwali u an. Kaiwena ginol o u ginol, inoke sauga ya na ba bilibili ni nak. Yawalim ana minamina gegewena elana nu tuwalali gagasisi ge nu lomwan mulaa abwe enowana nu an.
Pepesala ge mwawin nanakina nihi siunem bilibiliya kaiwem, yaa aanan nu eyowa-an ga mulaa abwe nu anan.
Nu tuwalali gagasisi lamwam ni alutan mulaa abwe nu anan, ana siga nu sikal bilibili elana, toto ya ahe ya ginoliwa. Kaiwena owa bilibili, yaka nu sikal nu tabwa bilibili.”
Adama lagona alana i tun Ive,
kaiwena iya gamagalau gegewel yawaliliya gaganina hinaliya.
Inoke Yehoba Yabowaine bwasumu kunisina i ahe Adama ge lagona ali kaliko i ginoliya yaka i pagaloil.

Yaka Yehoba Yabowaine i ba, “Gamagal iyaka bugul gegewena waiwaisana ge nanakina i atena ge i ola kila. Nige bosowaina ge ta talamwan yawal ana ebwakil enowana al ni ahe ni an, eba yawalina ni mihot.”
Inoke Yehoba Yabowaine tau ge yova i patuna owaowa-agil hi tagil Ideni eyowana elana, yaka tau bilibili ni eyowa-an, toto Yabowaine i ahe ge i ginoliya.
Tau ge yova i patuna owaowa-agil i mowasi, yaka bwasumu opeliya gaganina
ge elohaveyan kilepana tautauina i huli pwapwati labi gegewena elal, i telel Ideni eyowana labena balimana. Inoke kamwasa hi kausil bahi gamagal etega ni nonok yawal ana ebwakil elana.

footnotes.text: “Tubutubunina etega kokowam abwe ni puligebal ge owa aena gunina nu tal”: baaba ya ba kakanun te Yeisu Seitani wana gasisi ni pakokove, ge Seitani ni pihigelgel Yeisu wana boda elal. Pana Hibilu elana baaba ya ali sapu labui, bosowaina al ta pasikal ta ba, “Tubutubunina kokowam nihi puligebal ge owa aeliya gunina nu tal.” He mwata hot ge gamagalau hot baliya to.
Pana Hibilu elana alan “Ive” ana hago i ola vilan “yawaliliya gaganina.”
Bwasumu opeliya gaganina heliya aneloseyau gasigasisel bolo hi miminaa Yehoba manininaa.
